name: dsh-prompt-injector
description: Generic per-turn prompt injector for the DeepSeek Harness web profile — manage a list of context prompts (with enable switch) in the settings page; every round of conversation injects each enabled prompt as a notice line (「上下文注入 xxx」) into the model context, exactly like the mem0 recall reminder. Host-only logic + client settings card; zero dsh source changes.
